title: Serpentine Main Dam — Western Australia
visualBrief: Whole Serpentine Main Dam, Western Australia, as an approximate2007historical reconstruction: complete rolled-earth embankment and original23control physical dam boundary, whole five-control crest road/spillway bridge, full ten-control enlarged spillway canal, intrinsic offtake/control tower/access link and buried conduit. Government water-protection plan gives55m height and424m crest; heritage record identifies earthfill/spillway/control tower and explicitly records removal of the old curved concrete observation wall/platform/tainter gates in2001/2002. Those demolished elements are not reconstructed for2007;2022proposed crest raising is not treated as proof of completed current geometry. Native actual lengths preserved rather than stretched to rounded published dimensions. Exact ring/road/canal/conduit horizontal controls retained; vertical role of boundary, bank/foundation/road/channel sections, intake/control-tower registration/form, access bridge, roofs/fittings/finish/grade are estimates. Separate Pipehead Dam, detached cafe/tearoom, garden/fountain/playground and reservoir/park/interiors excluded as independent structures. No imagery used or photographic fidelity claimed.
